title: How do I create a post?
content: Tap the “+” icon on the home screen. Then, add text, images, or videos, and hit **Post** to share.

title: Who can see my posts?
content: Your posts are visible to anyone who visits your public profile.

title: How do I view other people’s posts?
content: Go to the **Explore** tab or visit a user’s profile to view their shared stories and posts.

title: Can I like or comment on posts?
content: Yes! You can like any public post and comment to share your thoughts or feedback.

title: How do I delete or edit my post?
content: Open your post, tap the **•••** icon, and choose **Edit** to update it or **Delete** to remove it permanently.

title: How do I report inappropriate content?
content: Tap the **•••** icon on any profile page and select **Report User**. Choose the reason and submit your report for review.
